title: Transcriptomic atlas reveals organ-specific disease tolerance in sickle cell mice
author: Grunenwald, Anne
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Genotype and select experimental mice
steps.instruction: Genotype all Townes model mice, select age‑ and sex‑matched HbAA (control) and HbSS (sickle cell) littermates that are 6–8 weeks old for the experiment.

steps.title: Anesthetize and inject hemin or PBS
steps.instruction: Anesthetize each mouse with isoflurane at 2–3% inhalation, then inject intravenously into the retro‑orbital sinus either hemin (Ferriprotoporphyrin IX, Frontiers Scientific) at 24 µmol kg⁻¹ or an equal volume of PBS for control mice.

steps.title: Sacrifice mice and harvest lungs
steps.instruction: Four hours after injection, sacrifice mice by cervical dislocation and immediately collect the lungs for downstream processing.

steps.title: Section and homogenize lung tissue
steps.instruction: Freeze the lungs, cut 30 µm‑thick sections, and homogenize each section in 200 µL of 1‑Thioglycerol/Homogenization Solution using the Maxwell® 16 LEV simplyRNA Tissue Kit (Promega, catalog AS1280).

steps.title: Assess RNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA, then evaluate its quality and quantity on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer with the Agilent RNA 6000 Nano Kit; only samples with RNA Integrity Number (RIN) > 7 proceed to library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare stranded mRNA libraries
steps.instruction: Use 1 µg of high‑quality total RNA (RIN > 7) and the Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA kit (manufacturer’s protocol) to (i) purify poly‑A mRNA, (ii) fragment it, (iii) reverse‑transcribe with random primers, (iv) synthesize second strand replacing dTTP with dUTP for strand specificity, (v) add a single A base to cDNA, and (vi) ligate Illumina adapters.

steps.title: Quantify and profile libraries
steps.instruction: Quantify each library by qPCR using the KAPA Library Quantification Kit for Illumina Libraries (KapaBiosystems, Wilmington, MA) and assess library size distribution with DNA High Sensitivity LabChip kits on an Agilent Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NextSeq 500
steps.instruction: Load the quantified libraries onto an Illumina NextSeq 500 and perform paired‑end sequencing with 75‑base reads using V2 chemistry.

steps.title: Perform primary data analysis
steps.instruction: Process raw sequencing data with AOZAN software (ENS, Paris) to demultiplex and run quality control using FastQC modules (version 0.11.5).
